title: Newspaper: Science, Tech & Health
sub: Terms from technology, medicine, and research stories.

cards.def:
A step-by-step set of rules for solving a problem.
हिंदी: एल्गोरिद्म / कलन-विधि
examples: Present: An algorithm ranks search results.
Past: The algorithm flagged the error.
Future: The algorithm will learn from new data.
Perfect: Engineers have improved the algorithm.

cards.def:
Computer systems that perform tasks needing human intelligence.
हिंदी: कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता
examples: Present: Artificial intelligence writes simple reports.
Past: Artificial intelligence changed the industry.
Future: Artificial intelligence will transform schools.
Perfect: Artificial intelligence has entered hospitals.

cards.def:
Using machines to do work without human effort.
हिंदी: स्वचालन
examples: Present: Automation reduces repetitive tasks.
Past: Automation replaced assembly workers.
Future: Automation will reshape jobs.
Perfect: Automation has increased output.

cards.def:
Protection of computer systems from attack.
हिंदी: साइबर सुरक्षा
examples: Present: Cybersecurity protects personal data.
Past: Cybersecurity failed at the bank.
Future: Cybersecurity will become a top priority.
Perfect: Firms have strengthened cybersecurity.

cards.def:
Turning data into code so others cannot read it.
हिंदी: एन्क्रिप्शन
examples: Present: Encryption keeps messages private.
Past: Encryption protected the files.
Future: Encryption will secure the payments.
Perfect: Apps have added encryption.

cards.def:
Facts and figures collected for analysis.
हिंदी: डेटा
examples: Present: Data guides decisions.
Past: The data showed a steady rise.
Future: New data will arrive tomorrow.
Perfect: Researchers have gathered more data.

cards.def:
Programs that run on a computer.
हिंदी: सॉफ़्टवेयर
examples: Present: Software controls the hardware.
Past: The software crashed twice.
Future: New software will arrive next week.
Perfect: The firm has updated its software.

cards.def:
The physical parts of a computer.
हिंदी: हार्डवेयर
examples: Present: Hardware needs regular upgrades.
Past: The hardware failed during the test.
Future: New hardware will improve speed.
Perfect: Engineers have replaced the hardware.

cards.def:
A system of connected computers or people.
हिंदी: नेटवर्क
examples: Present: A network shares information.
Past: The network went down for an hour.
Future: The network will expand to villages.
Perfect: The company has built a vast network.

cards.def:
A digital system on which services run.
हिंदी: प्लेटफ़ॉर्म
examples: Present: A platform connects buyers and sellers.
Past: The platform launched in 2019.
Future: The platform will add new features.
Perfect: The platform has gained millions of users.

cards.def:
To improve to a higher standard.
हिंदी: उन्नत करना
examples: Present: Phones upgrade automatically.
Past: They upgraded the system last month.
Future: We will upgrade the server tonight.
Perfect: The firm has upgraded all laptops.

cards.def:
A small fault in a system.
हिंदी: तकनीकी गड़बड़ी
examples: Present: A glitch can delay payments.
Past: A glitch shut down the app.
Future: A glitch will be fixed soon.
Perfect: A glitch has affected many users.

cards.def:
A first model of a product.
हिंदी: प्रोटोटाइप / नमूना
examples: Present: A prototype tests an idea.
Past: The team built a prototype in June.
Future: A prototype will be shown tomorrow.
Perfect: Engineers have completed the prototype.

cards.def:
An important discovery or advance.
हिंदी: बड़ी सफलता
examples: Present: A breakthrough can change medicine.
Past: Scientists announced a breakthrough.
Future: A breakthrough will save lives.
Perfect: Researchers have achieved a breakthrough.

cards.def:
A scientific test to learn something.
हिंदी: प्रयोग
examples: Present: An experiment tests a theory.
Past: The experiment failed twice.
Future: The experiment will run for a month.
Perfect: Scientists have repeated the experiment.

cards.def:
A proposed explanation to be tested.
हिंदी: परिकल्पना
examples: Present: A hypothesis guides research.
Past: The hypothesis proved correct.
Future: The hypothesis will be tested next year.
Perfect: Researchers have revised the hypothesis.

cards.def:
A room or building for scientific work.
हिंदी: प्रयोगशाला
examples: Present: A laboratory needs careful safety rules.
Past: The laboratory was built in 1990.
Future: The laboratory will open next year.
Perfect: The university has expanded its laboratory.

cards.def:
The complete set of genes in a living thing.
हिंदी: जीनोम
examples: Present: A genome carries genetic information.
Past: Scientists sequenced the genome.
Future: The genome will reveal the cause.
Perfect: Researchers have mapped the genome.

cards.def:
A change in genetic material.
हिंदी: उत्परिवर्तन
examples: Present: A mutation may alter a virus.
Past: A mutation made the virus spread faster.
Future: A mutation will be tracked closely.
Perfect: The virus has undergone a mutation.

cards.def:
A substance that protects against disease.
हिंदी: टीका
examples: Present: A vaccine trains the immune system.
Past: Scientists developed a vaccine in a year.
Future: A vaccine will reach villages soon.
Perfect: Millions have received the vaccine.

cards.def:
The body's ability to resist disease.
हिंदी: रोग-प्रतिरोधक क्षमता
examples: Present: Immunity weakens with age.
Past: Immunity developed after infection.
Future: Immunity will last several months.
Perfect: Many have gained immunity.

cards.def:
A sudden rise in disease cases.
हिंदी: प्रकोप
examples: Present: An outbreak can spread fast.
Past: An outbreak hit the city in May.
Future: An outbreak will strain hospitals.
Perfect: An outbreak has been reported.

cards.def:
A widespread outbreak of disease in a region.
हिंदी: महामारी (स्थानीय)
examples: Present: An epidemic requires quick action.
Past: An epidemic swept the state.
Future: An epidemic will be contained soon.
Perfect: The epidemic has claimed many lives.

cards.def:
A disease outbreak spreading across the world.
हिंदी: वैश्विक महामारी
examples: Present: A pandemic disrupts economies.
Past: The pandemic changed daily life.
Future: Another pandemic will test health systems.
Perfect: The pandemic has taught us lessons.

cards.def:
Isolation to prevent spreading disease.
हिंदी: संगरोध
examples: Present: Quarantine protects communities.
Past: He spent two weeks in quarantine.
Future: Travellers will enter quarantine.
Perfect: The ward has been placed in quarantine.

cards.def:
A sign of illness felt by a patient.
हिंदी: लक्षण
examples: Present: A fever is a common symptom.
Past: Symptoms appeared on the third day.
Future: Symptoms will fade in a week.
Perfect: The patient has shown mild symptoms.

cards.def:
Identifying an illness from its signs.
हिंदी: निदान
examples: Present: Early diagnosis saves lives.
Past: The diagnosis surprised him.
Future: A diagnosis will take two days.
Perfect: Doctors have confirmed the diagnosis.

cards.def:
Medical care given to a patient.
हिंदी: उपचार
examples: Present: Treatment varies by illness.
Past: Treatment began immediately.
Future: Treatment will last six weeks.
Perfect: She has completed her treatment.

cards.def:
Lasting a long time or constantly recurring.
हिंदी: दीर्घकालिक
examples: Present: Chronic pain affects daily life.
Past: He suffered from chronic asthma.
Future: Chronic conditions will need long-term care.
Perfect: She has had chronic fatigue for years.

cards.def:
Severe and sudden, or sharp.
हिंदी: तीव्र
examples: Present: Acute pain needs quick treatment.
Past: He had acute appendicitis.
Future: An acute shortage will worsen things.
Perfect: The region has faced an acute crisis.

cards.def:
Medical treatment by operating on the body.
हिंदी: शल्य चिकित्सा
examples: Present: Surgery needs skilled teams.
Past: Surgery lasted four hours.
Future: Surgery will take place on Monday.
Perfect: He has recovered from surgery.

cards.def:
A doctor's written order for medicine.
हिंदी: नुस्ख़ा
examples: Present: A prescription lists the dose.
Past: She collected her prescription.
Future: A prescription will be needed.
Perfect: The doctor has renewed my prescription.

cards.def:
A measured amount of medicine.
हिंदी: खुराक
examples: Present: A dose should be taken after meals.
Past: He took a double dose.
Future: A second dose will follow in a month.
Perfect: Patients have received the first dose.

cards.def:
An unwanted effect of a medicine.
हिंदी: दुष्प्रभाव
examples: Present: A side effect may include nausea.
Past: A side effect appeared after a day.
Future: Side effects will fade quickly.
Perfect: The drug has caused few side effects.

cards.def:
A medicine that kills bacteria.
हिंदी: प्रतिजैविक
examples: Present: An antibiotic treats bacterial infection.
Past: Doctors prescribed an antibiotic.
Future: An antibiotic will clear the infection.
Perfect: Overuse has weakened antibiotics.

cards.def:
Food needed for health and growth.
हिंदी: पोषण
examples: Present: Nutrition affects child growth.
Past: Poor nutrition stunted their growth.
Future: Better nutrition will improve health.
Perfect: Schools have improved nutrition.

cards.def:
A condition of excessive body fat.
हिंदी: मोटापा
examples: Present: Obesity raises health risks.
Past: Obesity increased among children.
Future: Obesity will strain health budgets.
Perfect: Obesity has become common.

cards.def:
Emotional and psychological wellbeing.
हिंदी: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य
examples: Present: Mental health matters as much as physical health.
Past: Mental health suffered during lockdown.
Future: Mental health will get more funding.
Perfect: Schools have prioritised mental health.

cards.def:
Treatment of a disorder, often through talking.
हिंदी: चिकित्सा / थेरेपी
examples: Present: Therapy helps manage stress.
Past: Therapy changed her outlook.
Future: Therapy will begin next week.
Perfect: He has attended therapy for a year.

cards.def:
Inability to stop using a harmful substance or habit.
हिंदी: लत
examples: Present: Addiction harms families.
Past: Addiction ruined his career.
Future: Treatment will help overcome addiction.
Perfect: He has battled addiction for years.

cards.def:
A substance that contaminates air, water, or soil.
हिंदी: प्रदूषक
examples: Present: A pollutant harms health.
Past: A pollutant seeped into the river.
Future: Filters will remove the pollutant.
Perfect: Factories have released a harmful pollutant.

cards.def:
Able to be replaced naturally, like sun or wind.
हिंदी: नवीकरणीय
examples: Present: Renewable energy is growing.
Past: Renewable sources powered the town.
Future: Renewable power will cost less.
Perfect: The state has invested in renewable energy.

cards.def:
Relating to the sun.
हिंदी: सौर
examples: Present: Solar panels convert sunlight to power.
Past: Solar power lit the village.
Future: Solar farms will spread across the desert.
Perfect: The school has installed solar panels.

cards.def:
An object orbiting the earth or another body.
हिंदी: उपग्रह
examples: Present: A satellite sends images of the earth.
Past: A satellite launched last night.
Future: A satellite will track storms.
Perfect: Engineers have repaired the satellite.

cards.def:
To travel around a planet or star.
हिंदी: परिक्रमा करना
examples: Present: The moon orbits the earth.
Past: The probe orbited Mars.
Future: The craft will orbit for a year.
Perfect: The satellite has orbited ten thousand times.

cards.def:
A huge system of stars, gas, and dust.
हिंदी: आकाशगंगा
examples: Present: A galaxy contains billions of stars.
Past: Astronomers discovered a distant galaxy.
Future: Telescopes will study the galaxy.
Perfect: Scientists have mapped the galaxy.

cards.def:
An instrument for seeing distant objects.
हिंदी: दूरबीन
examples: Present: A telescope shows faraway stars.
Past: The telescope captured a new planet.
Future: A new telescope will launch soon.
Perfect: Astronomers have upgraded the telescope.

cards.def:
The force pulling objects toward each other.
हिंदी: गुरुत्वाकर्षण
examples: Present: Gravity keeps us on the ground.
Past: Gravity pulled the rock down.
Future: Gravity will slow the rocket.
Perfect: Scientists have measured gravity precisely.

cards.def:
The smallest unit of an element.
हिंदी: परमाणु
examples: Present: An atom has a nucleus.
Past: Scientists split the atom.
Future: An atom will join with another.
Perfect: Researchers have imaged a single atom.

cards.def:
Relating to atoms' nuclei or their energy.
हिंदी: परमाणु
examples: Present: Nuclear power provides electricity.
Past: Nuclear tests alarmed the world.
Future: Nuclear plants will shut by 2030.
Perfect: The country has built nuclear reactors.

cards.def:
Energy emitted as waves or particles.
हिंदी: विकिरण
examples: Present: Radiation can harm cells.
Past: Radiation leaked from the plant.
Future: Radiation will decline over time.
Perfect: Workers have been exposed to radiation.

cards.def:
Fuel formed from ancient plants and animals.
हिंदी: जीवाश्म ईंधन
examples: Present: Fossil fuel produces carbon dioxide.
Past: Fossil fuel powered the Industrial Revolution.
Future: Fossil fuel will decline in use.
Perfect: Nations have reduced fossil fuel use.

cards.def:
Release of gas or pollutants into the air.
हिंदी: उत्सर्जन
examples: Present: Emission from cars pollutes cities.
Past: Emissions fell during lockdown.
Future: Emissions will drop by half.
Perfect: Factories have cut emissions.

cards.def:
The variety of life in an area.
हिंदी: जैव विविधता
examples: Present: Biodiversity keeps ecosystems healthy.
Past: Biodiversity declined with forest loss.
Future: Biodiversity will recover if forests return.
Perfect: Scientists have recorded rich biodiversity.

cards.def:
A community of living things and their environment.
हिंदी: पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र
examples: Present: An ecosystem depends on balance.
Past: The oil spill damaged the ecosystem.
Future: The ecosystem will take decades to heal.
Perfect: Pollution has harmed the ecosystem.

cards.def:
A group of similar living things.
हिंदी: प्रजाति
examples: Present: A species adapts to its habitat.
Past: A new species was discovered.
Future: The species will disappear without protection.
Perfect: Scientists have catalogued thousands of species.

cards.def:
No longer existing.
हिंदी: विलुप्त
examples: Present: Dinosaurs are extinct.
Past: The bird became extinct in 1900.
Future: The species will go extinct soon.
Perfect: Many animals have become extinct.

cards.def:
The natural home of an animal or plant.
हिंदी: आवास / प्राकृतिक वास
examples: Present: A habitat provides food and shelter.
Past: Loggers destroyed the habitat.
Future: The habitat will be protected.
Perfect: Tigers have lost their habitat.

cards.def:
Protecting nature and resources.
हिंदी: संरक्षण
examples: Present: Conservation saves wildlife.
Past: Conservation efforts began in 1970.
Future: Conservation will need public support.
Perfect: Groups have increased conservation work.

cards.def:
A long period of very little rain.
हिंदी: सूखा
examples: Present: A drought damages crops.
Past: A drought hit the region last summer.
Future: A drought will push up food prices.
Perfect: The area has suffered a drought.

cards.def:
An overflow of water onto dry land.
हिंदी: बाढ़
examples: Present: A flood destroys homes.
Past: A flood swept through the valley.
Future: A flood will follow heavy rain.
Perfect: The river has caused a flood.

cards.def:
A sudden shaking of the ground.
हिंदी: भूकंप
examples: Present: An earthquake can topple buildings.
Past: An earthquake struck at dawn.
Future: An earthquake will test the new design.
Perfect: The region has experienced an earthquake.

cards.def:
A large rotating storm.
हिंदी: चक्रवात
examples: Present: A cyclone brings strong winds.
Past: A cyclone hit the coast.
Future: A cyclone will arrive tonight.
Perfect: The state has prepared for the cyclone.

cards.def:
To move people away from danger.
हिंदी: खाली कराना
examples: Present: Officials evacuate coastal villages.
Past: Authorities evacuated the town.
Future: Residents will evacuate by noon.
Perfect: Thousands have been evacuated.

cards.def:
A long period of unusually hot weather.
हिंदी: लू / भीषण गर्मी
examples: Present: A heatwave can be deadly.
Past: A heatwave gripped the north.
Future: A heatwave will arrive next week.
Perfect: The city has endured a heatwave.

cards.def:
Long-term change in global weather patterns.
हिंदी: जलवायु परिवर्तन
examples: Present: Climate change melts glaciers.
Past: Climate change altered rainfall.
Future: Climate change will raise sea levels.
Perfect: Scientists have linked storms to climate change.

cards.def:
The rise in earth's average temperature.
हिंदी: वैश्विक तापन
examples: Present: Global warming worries scientists.
Past: Global warming accelerated after 1980.
Future: Global warming will melt more ice.
Perfect: Global warming has changed seasons.

cards.def:
A slow-moving mass of ice.
हिंदी: हिमनद
examples: Present: A glacier feeds rivers.
Past: The glacier retreated rapidly.
Future: The glacier will keep shrinking.
Perfect: The glacier has lost half its mass.

cards.def:
Fog mixed with smoke and pollution.
हिंदी: धुआँ-कोहरा
examples: Present: Smog irritates the lungs.
Past: Smog covered the capital.
Future: Smog will worsen in winter.
Perfect: Smog has returned this season.

cards.def:
Able to break down naturally.
हिंदी: जैव-अपघटनीय
examples: Present: Biodegradable bags decompose.
Past: The plates were biodegradable.
Future: Biodegradable packaging will replace plastic.
Perfect: Firms have adopted biodegradable materials.

cards.def:
To process used materials for reuse.
हिंदी: पुनर्चक्रण करना
examples: Present: Cities recycle paper and glass.
Past: They recycled old bottles.
Future: We will recycle more next year.
Perfect: The plant has recycled tonnes of plastic.

cards.def:
A site where waste is buried.
हिंदी: कचरा भराव क्षेत्र
examples: Present: A landfill produces methane.
Past: The landfill overflowed.
Future: The landfill will close next year.
Perfect: The city has expanded its landfill.

cards.def:
The study of heredity and genes.
हिंदी: आनुवंशिकी
examples: Present: Genetics explains inherited traits.
Past: Genetics advanced rapidly in the 1900s.
Future: Genetics will guide medicine.
Perfect: Researchers have unlocked new genetics.

cards.def:
To create an exact genetic copy.
हिंदी: क्लोन बनाना
examples: Present: Scientists clone cells.
Past: They cloned a sheep in 1996.
Future: Researchers will clone endangered animals.
Perfect: Labs have cloned several species.

cards.def:
A cell that can develop into many types.
हिंदी: स्टेम कोशिका
examples: Present: A stem cell can repair tissue.
Past: Doctors used stem cells to treat burns.
Future: Stem cells will aid future therapies.
Perfect: Researchers have grown organs from stem cells.

cards.def:
A machine that performs tasks automatically.
हिंदी: रोबोट
examples: Present: A robot assembles cars.
Past: A robot performed the surgery.
Future: Robots will fill dangerous jobs.
Perfect: The firm has deployed hundreds of robots.

cards.def:
An unmanned flying machine.
हिंदी: ड्रोन
examples: Present: A drone captures aerial images.
Past: A drone delivered the package.
Future: Drones will inspect power lines.
Perfect: Farmers have used drones for spraying.

cards.def:
Using body features like fingerprints for identification.
हिंदी: बायोमेट्रिक
examples: Present: Biometric scanners verify identity.
Past: The airport adopted biometric checks.
Future: Biometric systems will replace passwords.
Perfect: Banks have introduced biometric login.

cards.def:
Internet-based storage and computing.
हिंदी: क्लाउड
examples: Present: The cloud stores files online.
Past: They moved data to the cloud.
Future: Apps will run on the cloud.
Perfect: Firms have shifted to the cloud.

cards.def:
The capacity of a connection to carry data.
हिंदी: बैंडविड्थ
examples: Present: Bandwidth limits download speed.
Past: Bandwidth dropped during the match.
Future: More bandwidth will improve streaming.
Perfect: The firm has increased its bandwidth.

cards.def:
Existing on a computer rather than physically.
हिंदी: आभासी
examples: Present: Virtual classrooms connect distant students.
Past: The meeting was virtual.
Future: Virtual tours will be available.
Perfect: Schools have adopted virtual learning.

cards.def:
A device worn on the body.
हिंदी: पहनने योग्य उपकरण
examples: Present: A wearable tracks heart rate.
Past: A wearable detected his irregular rhythm.
Future: Wearables will monitor patients.
Perfect: Sales of wearables have soared.

cards.def:
Using living organisms to make useful products.
हिंदी: जैव प्रौद्योगिकी
examples: Present: Biotechnology produces medicines.
Past: Biotechnology transformed farming.
Future: Biotechnology will create new cures.
Perfect: The sector has attracted investment.

cards.def:
Evaluation of research by other experts.
हिंदी: सहकर्मी समीक्षा
examples: Present: Peer review checks scientific quality.

Future: Peer review will take months.
Perfect: Editors have completed peer review.

cards.def:
A research study testing a medical treatment.
हिंदी: चिकित्सीय परीक्षण
examples: Present: A clinical trial tests safety.
Past: A clinical trial began in January.
Future: A clinical trial will recruit volunteers.
Perfect: The drug has passed a clinical trial.

हिंदी: प्लेसीबो
examples: Present: A placebo has no active ingredient.

Future: A placebo will be given to controls.
Perfect: Researchers have compared drug and placebo.

cards.def:
A number that describes facts about data.
हिंदी: आँकड़ा
examples: Present: A statistic can mislead.

Future: A statistic will appear in the report.
Perfect: Analysts have quoted a new statistic.

cards.def:

हिंदी: सहसंबंध
examples: Present: Correlation does not prove cause.

Future: A correlation will be tested further.
Perfect: Studies have found a strong correlation.

cards.def:
To reach the highest point.
हिंदी: चरम पर पहुँचना
examples: Present: Cases peak in winter.
Past: Infections peaked in May.
Future: Prices will peak in July.
Perfect: The curve has peaked.

cards.def:
To make something less severe.
हिंदी: कम करना
examples: Present: Trees mitigate heat in cities.
Past: Dams mitigated the flood damage.
Future: New rules will mitigate pollution.
Perfect: Farmers have mitigated losses.

cards.def:
A person who leads in a new field.
हिंदी: अग्रणी
examples: Present: A pioneer opens new paths.
Past: She pioneered cancer research.
Future: A pioneer will receive the award.
Perfect: He has become a pioneer in robotics.

cards.def:
Most advanced and modern.
हिंदी: अत्याधुनिक
examples: Present: Cutting-edge tools help surgeons.
Past: The lab used cutting-edge technology.
Future: Cutting-edge designs will appear next year.
Perfect: The firm has built cutting-edge devices.
